points: Firms using AI in the 10 Apply AI strategic sectors: 7% in 2021, 18% in 2025
Energy rose from 18% to 34%, electronics from 12% to 30%
Across all EU sectors adoption reached 20% in 2025
read: JRC news release; full report (JRC146753) not opened
take: Official Eurostat-based baseline for benchmarking your sector's AI uptake; energy and electronics firms moved fastest, mobility, tourism and agri-food lag.
title: EU JRC: AI use in strategic sectors more than doubles since 2021
